status: public-script contract research; native cancellation not implemented or live-verified
observations: The submission runtime retains the initial preparation conduit token in stopConduitToken when sending. It is distinct from the response-issued token used for stream resume.
The stop handler POSTs /backend-api/stop_conversation with conversation_id and exclude_async_types. The latter is either [pro_mode] or [] depending on service feature state.
The stop handler adds x-conduit-token only when the retained stop token exists, and may add x-oai-turn-trace-id.
The handler awaits the HTTP operation, then locally aborts the request. It does not expose an explicit server-cancelled response schema in this function.
unverified: An authoritative indication separating server cancellation from naturally completed generation
Exact capability and exclusion behavior for models and asynchronous modes
constraints: Do not call this on personal history or another operation; use an explicitly created test fixture.
Do not infer confirmed server cancellation from a closed local stream or HTTP success.
No imported browser token or cookie is needed or authorized by this research.
